title: Restore database from a valid .db file
description: This test uploads a valid .db file to restore the database and expects a success response that includes a backup filename.

steps.description: Navigate to a page in the app that provides access to the database restore/import UI.
Attach a valid SQLite .db file in the file input.
Verify a success confirmation is visible.
Verify the UI displays a backup filename for the pre-restore backup.

title: Reject database restore when a non-.db file is uploaded
description: This test attempts to upload a non-.db file for restore and expects the UI to show a validation error and not proceed with restore.

steps.description: Navigate to a page in the app that provides access to the database restore/import UI.
Attach a non-.db file in the file input.
Verify a file type validation error is visible.
Verify no restore success confirmation is shown.
